role_and_message.evidence: The M figure still motivates underwater open-vocabulary segmentation through data scarcity, visual degradation, stable geometry and semantic misalignment.

panel_and_object_coverage.evidence: The class-number bar chart, nine category labels, eight visual/gray examples, 40 prior tiles, both semantic example groups and VLM remain.

labels_math_and_numbers.evidence: 7/7/10 counts, all category names and source text labels are retained. Original grammatical/spelling limitations such as Natural Sence and Water Sence remain unchanged.

connections_and_direction.evidence: The original pairing of visual observations and gray geometry is preserved; the VLM orange left I know and blue right I do not know arrows retain direction and example associations.

visual_encodings.evidence: All experimental imagery and geometric-prior color values remain original pixels. New panel backgrounds/headings organize the existing four parts without new scientific coding.

examples_and_data.evidence: Six source regions containing every empirical image, full 40-tile grid and original bar chart match native source pixels independently.

unsupported_additions.evidence: Panel headings restate source Fig1. Introduction pp1-2 explicitly supports geometry stability and underwater semantic ambiguity; no extra measured improvement or new per-example explanation is added.

complete_visible_content.evidence: Every source panel, category, complete data region and directional label is visible. Small original hatch fragments inside restored regions are cosmetic and reserved for blind quality scoring.

remaining_limitations: Original illustrative scope and source spelling/axis limitations remain. Layout and source-region seams are assessed independently by the blind quality judge.
